The capstone already stated the reflux ratio 0.22; the prompt now also states the 1100 Btu a pound water overhead, the module's own typed figure, so that held-for-literature constant is a condition of the problem (as OTUMARA states its 920 Btu a gallon) and the duty is reproducible by hand from the prompt alone. tegReboilerMMBtuHr.evidence: From the prompt alone: water 47 x (66.845130 - 5) = 2906.7211 lb/day, circulation x 3.6 = 10464.196 gal/day, sensible 9.3 x 0.55 x (368 - 109) = 1324.785 Btu/gal, overhead (1/3.6) x 1100 x 1.22 = 372.7778 Btu/gal, duty 10464.196 x 1697.5628 / 24000000 = 0.740151 MMBtu/hr; reproduces the engine value 0.7401512387317987 exactly. Six decimals round within 5e-7 of tol 1e-5. Neighbours fail: sensible only 0.5776, no reflux 0.7122.
